translations.web: The old man said, “Peace be to you! Just let me supply all your needs, but don’t sleep in the street.”
translations.bsb: “Peace to you,” said the old man. “Let me supply everything you need. Only do not spend the night in the square.”
translations.kjv: And the old man said, Peace be with thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.
translations.asv: And the old man said, Peace be unto thee; howsoever let all thy wants lie upon me; only lodge not in the street.
